subject: 介休城隍庙前殿倒座戏台

清代 · 历次修复
source_note: 所绘为前殿后面倒座戏台，整体五间、向院内出三间歇山抱厦。依据实际近正面照片保留卷棚硬山山面、抬高台基及左右短段拱门，移除工地人员和堆料。现存正殿属明代，不能据其年代将本图戏台标为明代原构。输入输出已目视核对。

Subject: the actual REAR-FACING OPERA STAGE attached to the FRONT HALL of JIEXIU CHENGHUANG TEMPLE 介休城隍庙前殿倒座戏台, exactly the subject in photo2. This is ONE elevated stage building, not the temple's main seven-bay hall. Preserve the THREE-BAY open stage porch with FOUR front wooden posts and delicate carved spandrels, its raised rectangular brick podium with a SINGLE SMALL RECTANGULAR passage at ground level slightly right of center, and the closed rear stage wall and door. Preserve the distinctive combination of the central forward-projecting HIP-AND-GABLE roof over the three-bay stage and the CURVED ROLL-TOP YINGSHAN hard-gable roof of the transverse structure behind it: the unusual rounded brick gable at the LEFT is clearly visible in the photo and must remain. The FRONT porch roof has a straight ornate ridge, raised end figures, three slender central ridge ornaments and moderately lifted corners; behind it the tiled roll roof has NO straight main ridge and has the real curved side gable. Only thin selective outlines of glazed ornament; keep most roof area white. Preserve the actual short lattice-window side sections under the rear roof to the left and right of the open stage. Maintain the photo's nearfrontal mild angle with the left side gable visible. Include the immediate low left and right flanking masonry with ONE arch opening in each as seen, ending shortly after the openings; do not include separate corner pavilions or other buildings cropped by the reference. Bottom stage parapet is the actual plain low brick wall; do not add new railings or broad central stairs. Remove workers, scooter, construction bricks and loose boards, scaffolding, wire, excavated dirt and construction debris. The ancient stage structure remains as photographed; stage openings WHITE, no black cavern. Sparse delicate outlines, no dense brick pattern, no solid shadows. historical_sources.title: 介休城隍庙
historical_sources.publisher: 介休文化云（介休市文化旅游发展委员会及市图书馆、博物馆、文化馆）
historical_sources.evidence: 现存正殿为明代遗构，其余建筑为清代与近年复原；戏台面阔五间、单檐卷棚硬山，前台明次间出歇山抱厦，台基高1.35米。页面若干纪年换算有笔误，本条不采用这些换算数字。

site_recommendation.name: 介休城隍庙
site_recommendation.sub: 倒座戏台 · 琉璃屋脊
site_recommendation.yearNote: 1750仅为清代建筑的约略年表位置，不是戏台确切竣工年；庙宇创建及现存明代正殿另有年代。
site_recommendation.lede: 卷棚硬山与向院内伸出的歇山抱厦组合成城隍庙倒座戏台，雕花雀替和琉璃脊饰连起祭祀、庙会与戏曲演出的空间。

facts.label: 五间戏台
facts.text: 戏台整体面阔五间，前台明间、次间向外出歇山抱厦，形成三间开敞台口。

facts.label: 分辨年代
facts.text: 庙宇起于明洪武年间，现存正殿为明代遗构；图中戏台按清代及后续修缮登记。

facts.label: 组合屋面
facts.text: 卷棚硬山顶与前出歇山屋面并置，琉璃屋脊和木雕装饰是建筑的重要识别特征。
